# discord-py-skills — agent contract for newr

- newr is the package manager for the discord-py-skills pack. Python 3.10+, stdlib only.
- Always run newr with --json: stdout is exactly one JSON object
  {ok, command, newr, data, warnings, error: {code, message, hint}|null}.
  Logs go to stderr. Prompts are disabled; a command that needs input
  fails with error.code "usage" and names the flag that replaces it.
- Exit codes: 0 success; 1 usage error; 2 environment error
  (Python < 3.10, missing or corrupt local source); 3 network error;
  4 build error (newr build).
- Install skills with: newr --json install --agent <name> all
  (or a skill name instead of "all"). Never parse the human output.
- Resolve "latest" from GET https://api.github.com/repos/drewdestar/discord-py-skills/releases/latest
  (field tag_name). No releases exist before v0.5.0 ships; fall back to main.
- Never invent a skill's contents. Load the real SKILL.md from disk
  after installing; see skills/using-discord-py-skills/SKILL.md for routing.
